info.name: Kinde Account API Keys Billing Entitlements API

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10 if parameter not sent.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The ID of the billing entitlement to start after.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: The ID of the billing entitlement to end before.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: The ID of the billing customer to retrieve entitlements for

params.name: max_value
params.description: When the maximum limit of an entitlement is null, this value is returned as the maximum limit

params.name: expand
params.description: Additional plan data to include in the response. Allowed value: "plans".

items.docs:
Returns all the entitlements a billing customer currently has access to
read:billing_entitlements
